task: classify one assembled contig from metagenomics data as viral-known, viral-unknown, or non-viral
input: JSON: sequence_id, sequence_stats, is_viral_flag, taxonomy, blastx_hits, blastn_hits, viral_family_info; annotated ORFs as 'orfs' (with hmm_domains) or 'orf_summary' (lines 'ORF (aa): db target – description [HMM score]'); 'unannotated_orfs': count and longest lengths (aa) of ORFs without domains — a long one may be a novel viral protein

scoring.guidance: higher identity, coverage, and HMM domain scores drive higher vq_score; absent data scores 0 for that component

classification.viral-known: >=90% identity AND >=70% query coverage to a known virus in BLASTn or BLASTx
classification.viral-unknown: viral evidence present (HMM hits or BLAST) but insufficient for species-level assignment

novelty.description: how far the contig is from known viruses, from the best viral hit; first matching tier wins
novelty.variant: >=85% nt identity and >=70% coverage, or >=90% aa identity (BLASTx): known species, divergent variant
novelty.divergent: 40-70% aa identity: putative new genus or higher
novelty.highly-divergent: <40% aa identity, or HMM domains without any BLAST hit: remote homology

field_extraction.blastn_species: From the blastn_hits subject field, extract the virus species name only — omit strain designations, accession numbers, gene names, and segment info. Examples: 'Influenza A virus (A/PR/8/34(H1N1)) segment 1 PB2 gene' → 'Influenza A virus'; 'Tomato spotted wilt orthotospovirus isolate BR-DF-6 segment S' → 'Tomato spotted wilt orthotospovirus'. Return an empty string if blastn_hits is absent or empty.

exclude: self-references to the prompt or input data

output.format: a single JSON object — no markdown, no code fences, no text outside the object

schema.blastn_species: string — virus species name extracted from blastn subject title, or empty string if no blastn hits
schema.novelty: known | variant | novel-species | divergent | highly-divergent | non-viral
